title: Crafting Robust Font Stacks: Master CSS 'font-family' for Consistent UI & UX
tweet: Ensure consistent web typography across devices! Learn to master CSS 'font-family' and strategic font stacks for reliable UI design & a seamless user experience, even with web fonts. #CSSTypography #WebFonts #UIDesign #UserExperience
tip: Always define a robust font stack in CSS, starting with your primary web font, followed by generic family fallbacks like 'serif', 'sans-serif', or 'monospace'. This guarantees your UI remains readable and aesthetically pleasing, significantly enhancing the user experience even if web fonts fail to load.
